nom: Murad Clarifying Gel Cleanser with Salicylic Acid

avis.titre: Loved it... and then immediately did not
avis.texte: So, i bought this in march of this year. I had some stubborn breakouts at the time, many closed comedones and some cystic break outs on my cheek area. My sister recommended this to me because it had helped her alot a couple years or so back. So in good faith i bought it, and i cant lie and say immediately it made things worse. It actually improved some of my concerns and i was feelinh super hopeful... but that quickly changed around my second almost third month of use. During that time frame my skin began peeling and never felt hydrated enough, my skin had become even more bumpier than before along my cheeks and jaw. And the cystic break outs were constant along my chin and jaw area, particularly on my right side (which will probably take a minute to reverse.). I decided to start using a gentler cleanser in the morning and this one at night and still, it only did so much to lessen my issues. Fast forward to a few days ago, my skin is full of PIH and PIE, and multiple inflammed breakouts... i finally stopped using this and instead reverted back to my peach slices snail rescue cleanser and just within those four days my barrier feels so much better, my breakouts although still present arent painful to the touch anymore and are far less red. I decided to investigate why this might be and i was so disappointed to find out through the acne clinic pore clogging ingredient checker that this and multiple of the acne control products from murad are full of pore clogging ingredients. H

I use it with my Clarisonic, and it helps keep my skin clear. Even after all these years. Over time I've switched other products in my skincare routine, and I think I've finally found a lineup of products that work for me, this cleanser included. Everyone's skin is different and will require different types of products. But if you are really struggling with acne, pick this up. Give it a try at LEAST for 6 months and see what it does for you. Some of the white bumps are coming to a head and red. My skin feels textured like sandpaper now. The smell is mild. I felt clean & application is smooth. Burns your eyes bad so be careful on that. Murad is usually great for me. Very sad that I didn't get a good result. Now time to try getting back to my clear, smooth skin I had for the first time in my life. White bumps aren't visible in picture, but the red ones are..

avis.titre: Happy with my product we will see how it does long term in m
avis.texte: Just wash your face 2x daily. I use a wash cloth and my fingers. And a timer afterwards

I received a sample of this product and fell in love. Even though I'm past the typical "acne age" I still occasionally have an issue. Since I began using this product I haven't had any problem at all. My 87 year old mother has issues with hard lumps under her skin until she began using this product. It's pricey but since it works, it will remain in my home.

avis.titre: It works! But can dry out your skin!
avis.texte: I love this stuff as it definitely took care of my hormonal acne from being pregnant. I have always had great, clear skin but since being pregnant my face has had breakouts. This stuff cleared it up within a week. I did notice over time from using it everyday AM/PM, my face started creating dry patches around my moth area and near my nose. I have cut back to only using it at night and making sure I moisturize right after!
I have struggled with adult acne for years. This has helped clear my face better than anything else And I have used pretty much everything I definitely recommend this product for adult women

I normally have dry skin so I don't have many breakouts except an occasional one from hormones once a month. Since COVID we have to wear masks at work everyday and it's caused lots of breakouts and acne near the chin and jaw area. Tried this and it cleared the acne BUT I put this all over my face Two days in a row and I now have a scaly texture all over my cheeks, jaw, and chin. It feels and looks scaly not peeling just textured. Exfoliation and moisturizer has not changed the scaly texture. Not sure what happened. Not using this product again... maybe not for my skin type. Feel like I have crocodile skin.

I have very sensitive skin, I have Lupus and my malar rash gets very easily irritated. With wearing a mask all day I really have terrible maskne and this has worked so well for me. I don't have any dry patches, no burning or red spots anywhere and the outbreaks have definitely gone down.

I'm sure everybody's body are different, which is probably why this product doesn't work for everyone. BUT I have subscription with ipsy and I had this particular product as a sample. I once had a lot of bumps and acne on my bum and tried this product while in the shower and avoided using a loofah on my bum and it helped a lot! I also use a toner (not Murad toner). I would keep buying and probably recommend to friends. The reason why I gave 4 stars instead was because the smell of the product can be a bit too much.

I love this cleanser. It's not too drying but my skin feels clean after using it. It's clarifying agents have removed dirt embedded in my pores and my skin looks better than it has in years. I highly recommend it for breakout prone skin!

I bought this product in a travel size package along with 2 other Murad items to give it a shot on clearing up my skin. I used it for the first time and it cleared up my skin immediately. Great, right?! No. I continued to use this product and over the course of a week I broke out horribly for the first time in years. It actually made my skin look worse than it did without using this product. I do not recommend this if you have cystic acne or sensitive skin.

avis.titre: This is my favorite cleanser ever.
avis.texte: First off, I love this product and will use it as long as it's on the shelf. Back in 2017 I began my masters degree and was so stressed (and broke). I had minimal breakouts in highschool and was completely unprepared for how my skin reacted with hormonal and stress changes. I had breakouts all over my face, some that were deep and painful. As a college student I had no idea how to tackle this problem on such a limited budget. I was recommended this product while getting a facial at massage envy. I LOVED that it wasn't outrageously expensive, it lasts awhile, and it is very effective. It gives a nice clean cooling sensation while using it and the salicylic acid helps fight acne and for those of us with sensitive skin it's also formulated with green tea extract to soothe inflammation and irritation. It can cause dryness but that's typical with any products with SA in them. I've never had a problem with this as long as I immediately use a toner and a moisturizer post shower! I'm so grateful for this product. Thank you Murad!

avis.titre: absolutely amazing and very helpful for adult acne
avis.texte: I never used to have issues with my skin until after aesthetics school and then I was having lots of white heads and papules, this product will dry out your skin but thats exactly what its supposed to do. To get real results you need to be using a hydrating serum and a good moisturizer with this. This product has helped clear all the small bumps and brought any prexisting acne down and drawn out everything that was in my skin.
Face felt clean but I think it broke me out more than it helped clear my skin

avis.titre: Did not work at all for me.
avis.texte: My face regularly stays fairly acne free, buu I do use a scrub when I shower. After using this the first time I noticed quite a bit of acne popping up, thought it might be a fluke but switched back to my regular go to brand and it went away. Decided to try this again recently after having no acne problems again and back the acne came. The biggest difference between this and my current product is the exfoliative beads in it. I guess my face just requires a rougher scrub to not have acne. It did smell nice though, shame it didn't work I was hoping something softer on my skin might work better.
I've been using this product for the past 2 years. Leaves your skin feeling tight. It also keeps away any acne I get from time to time. My absolute favorite I won't try any other face cleanser.
